happyPath.startup: Manifest and five real items reached 100%; lobby appeared only after all fulfilled.
happyPath.lobbyRefresh: Three room records rendered from /api/rooms with AUTO-REFRESH ACTIVE.
happyPath.validation: Empty call sign produced CALL SIGN NEEDS AT LEAST TWO CHARACTERS.
happyPath.join: Kestrel joined Crosswind Test; Canvas received focus and the game loop started.
happyPath.sprites: Ship/bullet/asteroid/pickup sprite frames rendered; gameplay reached collision, death, and timed respawn states.
happyPath.audio: Join executed the AudioContext resume path without warning or console error. Source overlap is additionally proven by the deterministic AudioEngine test because the browser runner cannot inspect audible output.
happyPath.leave: Leave arena stopped gameplay and immediately restored the lobby and its room refresh.
happyPath.pagesSubpath: A production build made with --base=/rotorloop/lab-03/ loaded its hashed JS/CSS, manifest, sprite/audio assets, and /api/rooms under that direct subpath; the lobby reached 100% with no console entries.
happyPath.console: No error, warning, or unhandled-rejection entries after startup, join, gameplay, leave, and failure recoveries.

failureGallery.recovery: Retry recovered path loaded /assets/rotorloop-sprites.svg; UI reported 404 case recovered.
Retry recovered path loaded /assets/arena.json; UI reported timeout case recovered.
Retry recovered path used a new controller and loaded /assets/arena.json; UI reported abort case recovered.
Retry recovered path loaded /assets/arena.json; UI reported malformed case recovered.

automatedComplements.resizeDpr: canvas.test.js changes devicePixelRatio from 1 to 2 and proves dimensions and transforms do not compound.
automatedComplements.hiddenBackground: input.test.js proves hidden/blur cleanup; loop.test.js proves a long background interval is clamped and old elapsed time is dropped on restart.
automatedComplements.overlappingAudio: events-audio.test.js dispatches two fired events and proves two distinct AudioBufferSourceNodes start.

limitations: The in-app browser does not expose audible waveform inspection, so successful resume/no-console-error is the manual claim; source overlap is asserted deterministically.

The in-app browser did not expose a reliable document.hidden toggle or DPR override; preserved behavior is covered by existing deterministic browser-surface tests instead of a fabricated manual claim.
